scope: Publication binding, PDF layout and offline bilingual interface. This is not empirical verification of demand, frontier capability or economic realization.

visualReview.method: All pages rendered with Poppler; contact sheets and enlarged key pages inspected. Every scientific figure inspected; English desktop and French mobile plus separate development witness inspected.

interpretationControls: All monetary and agent lifecycle events are modeled; actual jobs, collections and frontier invention runs are not claimed.
Paid development A is charged once; prospective retention charges only remaining B, and separate research C remains optional.
Selected enterprise is Beta-only in all three scenarios; primary confirmation contains zero capability campaigns and admissions.
128 independent seeds per scenario, shared across scenarios; 384 scenario/world evaluations are not 384 independent seeds.
Sensitivity uses 20 shared exogenous seeds across 136 settings; nine failed final admissions have unresolved rejection stage in aggregate summaries.
Capacity holdout uses 12 shared seeds across three conditions, separate from selected development witness.
Selected development witness demonstrates technically productive reuse but negative complete economic recovery.
False initial acceptance includes later refunded cases; residual unrefunded errors are not identified from summaries.
Profit is pre-tax; tax reserves constrain available cash rather than being deducted as an expense.
Development price profiles, untouched confirmation, central stress rows and analytic buyer threshold are distinctly labeled.
